audit.whatIsWrong: Four level-chart rows contradicted their own whys in both layers: Level 1 was 'Jax' although whys[0] says 'Ornn owns level 1'; Level 3 and Levels 4-5 were 'Ornn' although whys[2] and whys[3] describe Jax winning the extended trade; Level 6 was 'Jax' although whys[4] calls it 'genuinely even'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Ornn / Skill / Jax / Jax / Skill / Ornn / Ornn and it matches the prose exactly. At 48.14% this is a lane Jax has a mid window in and loses on either end — Ornn out-pokes with Bellows Breath before Counter Strike exists and free-builds resists off Living Forge afterwards.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/win[0] Ornn, phases[2]/win[2] Jax, phases[3]/win[3] Jax, phases[4]/win[4] Skill — matched pairs, with ratings realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] sits on the Levels 4-5 row but describes the level-6 ultimate, so the page promised a spike two levels early.
audit.why: Grandmaster's Might does not exist at 4-5. What Jax actually has there is ranked Counter Strike (13s at rank 3) and Empower against a Searing Charge on 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s — the knockup cooldown is the real window.
audit.corrected: whys[3] rewritten to the cooldowns that exist at that stage; the phase whys carry the numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate written as 'Grandmaster at Arms' in whys[3], spikes[1].text and mid; correct name is Grandmaster's Might.
audit.why: Fabricated ability name in three fields. Everything else in point 4 on this page is unusually good and correct — it already states that Counter Strike dodges basic attacks only and not Bellows Breath or the Searing Charge shockwave, and it describes the R ram consuming Brittle accurately.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster's Might used in all three.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase whys named Volcanic Rupture as the cooldown to track, but the page's own prose correctly identifies Searing Charge's knockup as the thing that flips the trade.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9s and creates the pillar; Searing Charge is 12-14s and is what actually knocks Jax up when it hits the pillar. The longer, more punishable cooldown is the E, not the Q.
audit.corrected: Phase whys now anchor to Searing Charge (14s at rank 1) with Volcanic Rupture named as the setup.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Ornn contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His opener: Bellows Breath cones you for Brittle and chip while you hold only Leap Strike. Concede the wave and farm.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ornn must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Counter Strike online: his autos whiff into it, recast to stun, then Leap in with Empower. It does not dodge his W cone.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Volcanic Rupture's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: bait Searing Charge (14s at rank 1) so the pillar knockup whiffs, then run a pre-item Ornn over while it is down.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might's resists carry the all-in, but a held Call of the Forge God (140s) ram detonates Brittle — even until he spends it.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms gives the Armor/MR burst and the every-third-hit on-hit — the moment his Searing Charge pillar is on cooldown you run a pre-item Ornn over.
edits.after: Ranked Counter Strike plus Empower runs a pre-item Ornn over — the moment his Searing Charge (14s) is on cooldown he has no knockup to break your trade.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms: the burst of bonus Armor and MR plus the every-third-hit magic on-hit turns the all-in lethal the instant his Searing Charge (E) is on cooldown and can't knock you up.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might: the burst of bonus Armor and MR plus the every-third-hit magic on-hit turns the all-in lethal the instant his Searing Charge (E) is on cooldown and can't knock you up.

edits.before: This is your best stretch, but it is a knife-edge, not a free win. You out-duel a pre-item Ornn 1v1 if you respect what E can and can't do: it eats his committed auto-attacks, NOT his W cone or his pillar. At 6 your Grandmaster at Arms armor/MR steroid plus the every-third-hit on-hit turns any all-in into a kill the moment his Searing Charge is on cooldown — that is your jump signal. The hard read is his R: Call of the Forge God's first pass slows you and stacks Brittle, and the recast ram knocks you up while consuming Brittle for bonus damage and a longer lockup, so never commit into a held ultimate. Make him spend E or R first, then go.
edits.after: This is your best stretch, but it is a knife-edge, not a free win. You out-duel a pre-item Ornn 1v1 if you respect what E can and can't do: it eats his committed auto-attacks, NOT his W cone or his pillar. At 6 your Grandmaster's Might armor/MR steroid plus the every-third-hit on-hit turns any all-in into a kill the moment his Searing Charge (14s) is on cooldown — that is your jump signal. The hard read is his R: Call of the Forge God's first pass slows you and stacks Brittle, and the recast ram knocks you up while consuming Brittle for bonus damage and a longer lockup, so never commit into a held 140s ultimate. Make him spend E or R first.

notes: This page's ability text was already accurate — it correctly states that Counter Strike dodges basic attacks and not Bellows Breath or the pillar shockwave. The defects were the level chart (four rows contradicting their own whys in both layers), whys[3] describing the level-6 ultimate on the Levels 4-5 row, and 'Grandmaster at Arms' for Grandmaster's Might in three fields. Data note: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json lists Bellows Breath range as 25000, a parsing artifact — nothing here was written from it.
